notes.title: Patch 1.07
notes.content:
Hey,

Today we release Patch 1.07.


General Changes:
- Now you can produce Beer. (Brewing System)
- New Adventures.
- New hovering UI on the Objects.
- New growing FX.

Features:
- Potatoes has been added.
- Mango has been added.
- New Smith System (adventurer system)

World:
- Hops has been added.
- Mushrooms has been added.

notes.title: Patch 1.06
notes.content:
Hey,

Today we release Patch 1.06.

General Changes:
- UI has been improved.

Features:
- The tree plantation has been expanded.
- Mango has been added.

World:
- New Cave has been added.

Enviroment:
- Goats has been added.

Greetz.

notes.title: Patch 1.05
notes.content:
Hey,

Today we release Patch 1.05.

Features
- You can now drink beer at the inn.
- The fruits on the trees now react to physical effects.
- Harvest rotted after a limited time.

Enviroment

- Bunnys added.

Other
- Various Bug fixes and optimizations.

Greetz DigitalWolfByte

notes.title: Patch 1.04
notes.content:
Hey,

Today we release Patch 1.04.


Features
- Cherry tree added
- pear tree added
- New level system(Mining and Agriculture)
- Friendship system(Barkeeper)
- Various recipes

Enviroment

- Chickens added
- New Dynamic Weather

Greetz DigitalWolfByte

notes.title: Patch 1.03
notes.content:
Hey,

Today we release Patch 1.03.


[b]Features[/b]
- You can now upgrade various buildings / structures to produce faster.
- Strawberrys are now available.
- You can now put different tree species to get fruits.
- The barkeeper gives you daily Quests.

[b]Enviroment[/b]
- Birds are added.


Greetz DigitalWolfByte

notes.title: Patch 1.02
notes.content:
Hey,

Patch 1.02 is released.

- Seedmaker 
- Upgrade Storage
- New Quest
- Cows now produce Fertilizers after time 

Greetz Digital Wolfbyte

notes.title: Patch 1.01.1
notes.content:
Today we release a bugfixes patch.

- Various UI Fixes
- The Bake UI display now if you have everything you need for producing.

Greetz DigitalWolfByte
- Merry Christmas @all

notes.title: Patch 1.01
notes.content:
- You can now process your products and thus increase your energy!
- 2 new structures
- Wheat Fields (before quest)
- A little quest line!
- Some new Achievements.

- A little surprise that will be released on 20.12.

The Update will release on Monday.

Greetz Digital Wolfbyte

notes.title: Release
notes.content:
The overhauled Yerah is now officially released and playable for everyone.

We hope you enjoy and give us feedback!

- Digitalwolfbyte
